name: APL Apollo Tubes Ltd
title: APL Apollo Tubes Ltd - 533758 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA/ton held near INR5,500 but April-May volumes flat (2.5 lakh t in April) amid steel shortage and channel destocking; management protecting margin over volume, FY27 guidance of 15-20% volume and 20-25% EBITDA growth retained.

capex.quote: our target remains the same, around INR500 crores, INR600 crores yearly capex

triggers.label: Market share 55% to 65% FY26
triggers.quote: our market share is improved to 65% from 55%

triggers.label: HRC up ~INR3,000/t Apr-May
triggers.quote: they are up by around from March to May

triggers.label: FY27 volume 15-20%, EBITDA 20-25% held
triggers.quote: we are targeting 15% to 20%. EBITDA growth is 20% to 25%

guidance.quote: For FY '27, our volume growth is very clear -- we are targeting 15% to 20%.
EBITDA growth is 20% to 25% and PAT growth is 25% to 30%.
EBITDA growth is 20% to 25% and PAT growth is 25% to 30%.
our long-term plan of 8-million-ton capacity by FY '28 remains totally on-track
around INR500 crores, INR600 crores yearly capex
